stem.text: The red panda, Ailurus fulgens, is an endangered animal found in parts of Asia.
Table 6.1 shows part of the classification of the red panda.
Complete Table 6.1 to show the red panda’s domain, genus and species.

explanation.text: A binomial gives the genus followed by the specific epithet. The red panda is a eukaryotic animal, so its domain is Eukarya.

stem.text: Many zoos around the world have been breeding red pandas for over 80 years. The total number of red pandas in these zoos is currently estimated as 1000 individuals.
In the last 80 years the total number of red pandas living in the wild has halved to approximately 10 000 individuals. This is mostly due to loss of suitable habitat.
In 2011, for the first time, red pandas that had been born in a zoo were released into the wild.
Evaluate the success of efforts to conserve the red panda.

explanation.text: Evaluate both an insurance population and recovery in the wild. Continued captive breeding can preserve the species even while habitat loss means that wild populations keep declining.
